chunks.title: A novel approach to estimate power demand of auxiliary engine loads of light duty vehicles
chunks.text_excerpt: Alternators are the primary source of electric energy within a vehicle. The electric power demand of a contemporary automobile has rapidly increased along with the increase in use of electrical devices.

chunks.title: A novel approach to estimate power demand of auxiliary engine loads of light duty vehicles
chunks.text_excerpt: Simply stated, an alternator is a synchronous alternating current (AC) electric generator with direct current (DC) diode recti ﬁcation and pulse-width modulation voltage control ( SAE International, 2011). It consists of a rotor, stator, diode recti ﬁer, and voltage regulator. An automotive alternator has an ef ﬁciency of about 55%
